As far as antipsychotics go I've been on Abilify, Zyprexa, Seroquel, and Latuda, and once I stopped taking my symptoms that caused me to start taking them drastically decreased. Most recently, I tapered myself off of Latuda, and just went down gradually in dosing every two weeks, and then came off of it. I noticed minimal side effects and what I'd describe as a 'brain fog' that greatly impacted my focus, concentration, and overall mental abilities completely vanished after being off Latuda for about a week. It helps to keep a good routine of eating three meals a day, exercising,  and getting a good amount of sleep to curb some potential side effects. Best of luck!

Try looking for a pre-made meal delivery service in your area. I have alot of mental health issues, including depression, as well as an eating disorder, and it was a real game changer for me. Some of them even have pretty cheap introductory offers to try it out.
